snippet.title: [VLAST] Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
play free here https://tmdev.itch.io/vlast
frenetic, hard and heavily stylized, this top down shooter is not for everyone

1 or 2 players, 4 Gamemodes (PVP/PVE/COOP/ENDLESS)

Twin stick shooter on controller, "Hotline miami" style controls for mouse+keyboard

A game by TM
Audio and OST by SyntaxMisteik
